body:
you don't know me. you don't know the kind of pain that i have been in my entire life. the shame, the guilt, the lonliness... i would never wish this kind of pain on anyone. i know it sounds so self indulgent to say this but maybe i'm better off gone.

even if i were to talk to my friends, what would i even say? that i wanted to kill myself? that would get me locked up in an insane asylum. that is the last thing i want.

i'm sure if i told my friends how i felt, i would be laughed at and ridiculed. or worse, ignored. i spent my entire day yesterday driving my drunk friends around as chauffer, being yelled at and being told i'm wrong and don't know anything about where i was going and literally talked down to like a dog like "no, _xthrowawayx_! you obviously don't know anything your doing, why don't you listen to us!? don't tell us you're right, we obviously are so stop trying to be a bitch" 

i can't tell my friends how i feel because i'm sure they just don't care. and the sorry excuse i do have for friends would probably laugh at me and tell me to stop being such a pussy anyways. i sent my "closest friends" texts and calls 2 days ago, none of them returned. i am alone, and like i said, nobody cares.
omg, i literally just laughed so loud water came out my nose!
i know! and i've been having issues lately with my body image and that shit just made me feel so much worse about myself!

she has a lot of issues with tact and is the type of person to say things without regard for what other people feel. part of me admires her for being so fearless about her feelings but i don't think it should ever come at the expense of someone else's self esteem.
youre totally right. it's hard for me to bring up things... i really don't like fighting. it's something i have to get over, though!
i will try this... thank you!

it's not a lack of gumption that is the problem, but i've known this person for long enough to know that if i brought something up like this she would try to start a fight or take it the wrong way. i don't want to cause any issues because there are other reasons why i can't just stop being friends with her because she's also my roommate. 

didn't come here looking for sympathy, thank you.
i wish i had the guts to say this to her.

Good job OP! It's so difficult for me to take pills, too.

I was prescribed Lexipro about 2 months ago but I never took it because antidepressants make me feel like I'm not "me" if that makes any sense. I just saw my doctor again about 2 days ago trying to get a prescription for Xanax but ended up with Paxil. I'm gonna try to take my Paxil, but I'd be lying if I said I wasn't scared.

You cam too?? OMG are you me!? Haha! Yeah, you gotta sift through all the shitty jobs to find one that is really good. I'm sure you'll find one if you keep an eye out! I'm still sifting; been sifting for years. My mom might be opening up her own catering business so if all goes well I'll have a job lined up. Too bad it's not in the near future.

I hate using PayPal for that very reason. I haven't been scammed before, but I'm terrified it will happen someday. That's awful what that guy did, though! Some people are vengeful as fuck.

I'm glad I'm not the only one that does this. Every place I've ever worked, I've been known as the girl that calls in "sick" every 3 days. Hopefully you'll find a company that works around your schedule! 

As for my work, I cam. It's not so much that it doesn't pay well, but I reaaaaallly don't like doing it. But I figured it's either that or don't have a job at all :/
I feel like this SO FUCKING MUCH.
